Spring Equinox (Ostara)

A Day of Spring Equinox Renewal

Welcome the return of light and balance with a day dedicated to spring's gentle awakening and the promise of new growth.

  1. Sunrise

    Greet the Dawn

    Begin your day by observing the sunrise, welcoming the returning light and the promise of new beginnings as day and night near equal length.

  2. Late Morning

    Nurture New Growth

    Spend time outdoors, perhaps tending to early garden work, planting seeds, or simply observing the awakening natural world around you.

  3. Midday

    A Fresh Spring Lunch

    Enjoy a light and refreshing meal featuring the first tender greens and eggs, celebrating the earth's early bounty and fresh flavors.

    Recipes: Spring Herb and Feta Frittata · Ostara Naturally Dyed Eggs · Tender Spring Vegetables with Lemon-Herb Dressing

  4. Afternoon

    Mindful Balance

    Take a moment for quiet reflection or a gentle walk, finding your own inner balance as the natural world shifts into equilibrium.

  5. Late Afternoon

    Spring Preparations

    Gather fresh ingredients and begin preparations for a celebratory dinner, embracing the season's vibrant offerings and the joy of creation.

  6. Evening

    Feast of Renewal

    Share a vibrant meal highlighting seasonal plates with fresh herbs, eggs, bright citrus, and tender vegetables, honoring the abundance of spring.

    Recipes: Spring Herb and Feta Frittata · Ostara Naturally Dyed Eggs · Spring Equinox Citrus Salad · Tender Spring Vegetables with Lemon-Herb Dressing

  7. Night

    Reflect and Recharge

    Wind down with gratitude for the day's light and the renewed energy of spring, looking forward to the growth and vibrancy of the coming season.

May your home be filled with the vibrant energy and balanced renewal of the Spring Equinox.
